Free Online FIT to CSV Converter

FIT2CSV converts .fit activity files into one complete CSV file that is easier to inspect, analyze, archive, or provide to data and AI tools. The conversion happens locally in your browser, so your original workout file is not uploaded or stored on a backend server.

How to convert FIT to CSV

  1. Export or download the .fit activity file from your device or fitness platform.
  2. Drop the FIT file into the converter above or click to browse.
  3. Review the activity summary and FIT lap data.
  4. Click Download Full CSV to save the decoded FIT data.

FIT data preserved in one CSV

The exported CSV contains the FIT messages and fields exposed by the parser, including available activity, session, lap, record, event, device, GPS, heart-rate, cadence, power, altitude, and running-dynamics data. FIT2CSV does not add coaching scores or derived training metrics to the downloaded file.

Works with FIT activity files

FIT is commonly used by GPS watches, bike computers, and fitness devices. FIT2CSV is designed for standard FIT activity files from devices and platforms such as Garmin, COROS, Polar, Suunto, and other FIT-compatible sources.

Private by design

File reading and FIT decoding run in your browser using local JavaScript. There is no activity-file upload endpoint and no database used to store your workout data.

FIT to CSV FAQ

Is FIT2CSV free?

Yes. The converter can be used online without uploading your FIT file to a backend server.

Are my FIT files uploaded?

No. FIT files are read and decoded locally in your browser and are not stored by FIT2CSV.

Can I convert Garmin or COROS FIT files?

Yes. FIT2CSV is intended for standard FIT activity files, including files produced by Garmin and COROS devices.

What does the Full CSV contain?

It contains the decoded FIT messages and fields exposed by the parser in one CSV, without adding derived coaching metrics.
